name: BidPrime
description: Access your BidPrime leads inboxes including bids, meeting keyword alerts and emerging opportunities - including matching document content for summarizing and evaluating new bids and opportunities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BidPrime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BidPrime to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bidprime.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BidPrime MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidPrime provides these MCP tools: get_bid_detail, get_emerging_opp_detail, get_meeting_detail, list_bids, list_emerging_opps, and list_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BidPrime?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BidPrime in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
BidPrime requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BidPrime is developed by BidPrime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
